singapore.title: CNA Now: Simba faces possible licence suspension, plus other news as it happens
singapore.summary: Stay on top of the day's biggest stories with CNA Now, which brings you breaking news and major developments from Singapore and around the world.

singapore.title: Taking leave, buying PS5s and getting their partners' approval: How Singapore gamers are preparing for GTA 6
singapore.summary: After a 13-year wait, Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) launches on Thursday (Nov 19). From taking unpaid leave to buying new gaming setups, Singapore fans share how they're preparing for the big day.

singapore.title: Simba does not contest unauthorised spectrum use, other licence breaches; director set to resign
singapore.summary: Simba has informed Singapore's regulatory authorities of the circumstances surrounding the unauthorised use of the spectrum bands and the remediation steps to prevent recurrence.

singapore.title: Singapore assessing impact of new US chip export controls aimed at curbing China’s access
singapore.summary: Under the new US restrictions, a licence will be required to export, re-export, or transfer (in-country) advanced semiconductors to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, or Brazil.

singapore.title: Commentary: Why readiness matters now for Singapore’s nuclear energy question
singapore.summary: With limited domestic energy resources, retaining that ability to choose whether to deploy nuclear energy is itself an important part of energy security for Singapore, says Dr Victor Nian from the Centre for Strategic Energy and Resources.

singapore.title: No amount of laws or policing can prevent unrest without good governance: Shanmugam
singapore.summary: Speaking in an interview with CNA, Senior Minister K Shanmugam said protests are not the only way to be heard and that many avenues are available.

singapore.title: Singapore's first Zero Waste Hub opens in Nee Soon South, 7 more planned by 2028
singapore.summary: The hub in Yishun has separate recycling bins for plastic, paper, metal and glass, collection points for secondhand clothes and electronic waste, and a station for residents to refill household detergent using their own containers.

singapore.title: Lions won't be intimidated by Brazil, will focus on what's within control: Gavin Lee
singapore.summary: Singapore will take on football powerhouse Brazil at 6pm on Tuesday at the National Stadium, with the match up between Japan and Paraguay taking place shortly after at 9.10pm.

singapore.title: Ang Mo Kio residents face longer walks, route disruptions from traffic changes around AMK Hub
singapore.summary: Area residents told CNA on Monday (Nov 16) that the new pedestrian routes were confusing or more tiring, while motorists dealt with longer waiting times and unexpected detours.

singapore.title: Jail for man who flew to Cambodia for 'customer service' job but found scam syndicate targeting Singaporeans
singapore.summary: The syndicate offered the young man a 5 per cent commission and gave him a script, an iPhone and a list containing Singaporeans' personal details.

singapore.title: Safer, smoother, more fun: Joo Chiat's Shibuya-style crossing gets warm welcome from pedestrians, businesses
singapore.summary: Residents and pedestrians are celebrating a faster, easier walk at the busy Joo Chiat Road junction, but some motorists are bemoaning longer waits and detours.

singapore.title: MSC Cruises to launch Singapore-based sailings from 2028, with voyages across Southeast Asia
singapore.summary: Under a three-year partnership with the Singapore Tourism Board, MSC Orchestra will begin operating eight- to 12-night cruises from Singapore in late 2028, with stops in countries including Thailand, Vietnam and Indonesia.

singapore.title: SFA lifts suspension of Deli Hub Catering after gastroenteritis cases at two MOE kindergartens
singapore.summary: The caterer has complied with measures stipulated by the Singapore Food Agency, including cleaning and sanitising its premises and having food workers undergo food safety training again.

singapore.title: More than half of households that left ComCare assistance in 2022 returned within 3 years: MSF
singapore.summary: Households with stable employment were less likely to return to ComCare assistance, while caregiving responsibilities and health issues remained barriers to financial independence.

singapore.title: Former project manager handling West Coast Town Council tenders gets jail for taking S$50,000 bribe
singapore.summary: He accepted S$50,000 in cash from a contractor, whose firm later won a S$3.3 million project covering 41 blocks in Teban Gardens, Pandan Gardens, West Coast Drive and Jurong West.

world.title: Robert Pattinson may look the part of James Bond, but he's more against type than it seems
world.summary: Pattinson has spent much of his screen career subverting the kind of swaggering masculinity that Bond personifies.

world.title: Commentary: Microsoft outage shows that big tech can’t be treated as too big to fail
world.summary: Centralisation, consolidation and unchecked monopolies have left our digital lives, our businesses and our governments in an incredibly precarious place, says this academic.

world.title: Wall Street ends sharply lower on AI jitters ahead of Nvidia results, Anthropic IPO
Lindsay Clancy to face March retrial in deaths of her 3 children
world.summary: Her lawyers claim she suffered from postpartum psychosis, while prosecutors argue that she planned the killings and knew what she was doing.

world.title: Trump says 'would not mind' Huang being reinstated at Nvidia
world.summary: The US president said “I would certainly not mind seeing that,” expressing support for Jensen Huang's possible return as Nvidia chief.

world.title: US to curb China's access to AI chips as Trump heads to Asia
world.summary: The restrictions aim to stop China from accessing advanced US chips through other countries.

world.title: Tesla plans US$3.3 billion Cybercab boost for Germany's troubled auto sector
EU nations unveil Rwanda deal for migrant return hub
world.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have agreed to establish a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda to facilitate the return of migrants without legal residency in Europe.

world.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of anti-Houthi coalition: state media
world.summary: Saudi authorities named chief of staff General Fayyad bin Hamed bin Ruqad al-Ruwaili as the coalition's new commander.

world.title: Trump says he might meet with North Korea's Kim Jong Un in China
US flights nearly back to normal after rare no take-off order
world.summary: As of Monday (Nov 16) there were just 300 flight cancellations and 1,500 delays, down from more than 2,300 cancelled and 11,000 delayed Sunday, according to FlightAware.

world.title: British actor Robert Pattinson named as new James Bond
world.summary: Denis Villeneuve, an Oscar nominee known for movies such as the Dune trilogy and Arrival, is set to direct the new film, with a script written by Briton Steven Knight.

world.title: Iraq orders army to enter stronghold of Iran-backed group
world.summary: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi "ordered the armed forces to enter" Jurf al-Sakher, a stronghold of the powerful, Iran-backed Kataeb Hezbollah group, following accusations of oil smuggling.

world.title: Sri Lanka gets FBI help to crack down on online scammers
world.summary: An FBI team will spend a week in Sri Lanka this month training local investigators and helping to identify victims, trace criminal activity and build stronger cases against those responsible for online scams.

world.title: DR Congo-Rwanda row derails Francophone summit vote
world.summary: The Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) had intended to choose a new secretary general during talks in the Cambodian capital Phnom Penh.
